A mythological animal with one horn on its forehead
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Unicorn"** refers to a mythological animal with one horn on its forehead. (एक सींग वाला पौराणिक जानवर)

 
 
• **Example: **In many fairy tales, a** unicorn** is often depicted as a majestic creature with magical powers.
 
 
 
• **"Unicorn"** is derived from Latin, where 'uni' means one and 'cornu' means horn. (एक सींग वाला पौराणिक जानवर)
 
 
• **Example: **The** unicorn **is often seen as a symbol of purity and grace in various mythologies.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Unicameral **(एक सदनीय): Referring to a single legislative or parliamentary chamber.

 
 
• **Example:** The state adopted a unicameral system to simplify the legislative process.
 
 
 
• **Unipod **(एक पायावाला): Referring to something that has only one foot or leg, often used to describe monopods used in photography.
 
 
• **Example: **He used a unipod to stabilize his camera for the perfect shot.
 
 
 
• **Unific** (एकतामूलक): Pertaining to the process of unifying or making something into one.
 
 
• **Example:** The unific efforts of the team led to a successful project completion.
